confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, coffee, beer, cocktail and wine anchors come from aggregated Denver sources (Numbeo-style crowdsourced figures, an Expatistan Denver page labelled July 2026, Wise, and Denver bar roundups) that disagree somewhat and have inconsistent date stamps. Cocktail is the least certain drink anchor, set from Denver bar and national ranges and about 2x the beer price. Wine_glass comes from Numbeo glass estimates and a national average, about 1.6x beer. Midrange meal is a blend of source figures (roughly 80 to 150 for two, depending on drinks and tip). Tax and tip treatment varies by source. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for Denver in July peak season; no accommodation searches or booking-page checks were run, and they may be off by roughly 25 percent. FX was read from search-result text for the RBA page, not a direct page fetch; 18 Nov 2026 is the latest observation located.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are Denver-specific, drawn from aggregated Denver price data, with national US averages used as cross-checks for cocktail and wine. Hostel and hotel tiers are holistic estimates for Denver in July, not based on a named comparable city.
